senses.sense_definition: Having an unhealthy or excessive interest in sexual matters.

examples.text: The tabloid newspaper was criticized for its <w>prurient</w> focus on the private lives of celebrities.
He had a <w>prurient</w> interest in the details of the scandal that made everyone else uncomfortable.

senses.sense_definition: Designed to arouse or appeal to sexual desire.

examples.text: The film was banned for containing <w>prurient</w> scenes that were deemed inappropriate for general audiences.
Critics argued that the magazine cover was purely <w>prurient</w> and lacked any artistic merit.

senses.sense_definition: Inappropriately curious about the private or scandalous affairs of others.

examples.text: She refused to answer his <w>prurient</w> questions about her family's financial troubles.
The public's <w>prurient</w> fascination with the trial led to a media frenzy.
